requirements: R1: The Flyway validation error for the missing migration 20260904202315126 is resolved.

slices.title: Repair runtime initialization and mount configurations
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fixes for this epic, I want to resolve the missing migration error and script mount issue, so that the environment initializes properly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a deployed environment,
When the initialization configurations are updated to address Flyway and script mount issues,
Then the backend and backup containers must start successfully without errors,
And QA verification must confirm the health check endpoint is reachable.
